hypothesis: On the last 3 months of BTC/ETH 5m data (a down-trending regime), a vol-scaled barrier + z-filter bidirectional momentum config (same family as W8-3) can produce backtest results at least as good as Alpha 1%'s recorded baseline (synthetic doc: 0.00% return, 33.3% WR; plus a real-data Alpha-1-semantics benchmark on the same window).
relation: User-demanded 3-month window evaluation. Same search family as W8-3 (vol-scaled barriers + z-filter, 432 combos) re-registered on a NEW data window. W8-1/2/3 all NO-GO at IS stage, so the full-window OOS holdout was never consumed; W8-4 defines its own IS/OOS split inside the 3-month window. Not a retune of any closed grid: new window = new registration.

data.oos_holdout: last 20% (2026-07-28 19:59 to 2026-08-16 05:35, 5,300 bars), consumed once at final gate

selection_gates.selection_metric: median net annualized Sharpe across 5 time folds (IS)

benchmarks.alpha1_synthetic_doc: backtest_performance_analysis.md: 6-month synthetic sim, 12 trades, 33.3% WR, 0.00% combined return
benchmarks.alpha1_real_semantics: long-only unconditional churn (momentum_k=0, direction='long', TP/SL 2%, H=15, 3% size, breaker 3->50) on SAME 3-month window, net 0.1%/side
benchmarks.buy_and_hold: BTC+ETH equal split over same window (measured: -20.2% BTC)

verdict_rule: GO only if IS gates pass AND MC robustness passes AND OOS net Sharpe > 0 AND trades >= 20 AND beats B&H AND net return >= Alpha-1 real benchmark on the same window. Otherwise NO-GO.
no_retuning: Closed grid. Any follow-up requires a new registration.
